title: The Wolf Howling at the Solitary Moon Goes On

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of the summer training camp.
Training wrapped up by evening,
but I wonder where Sirius Symboli went.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw her ditch the other girls
and head out for a swim by herself, but...
choice_data_list: Don't tell me she went long-distan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with an Umamusume's athletic prowess,
swimming far out alone is dangerous. Worried,
I go look for her—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-san? Well,
I heard the girls she left behind saying
she swam over to that islet over there...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
It's close enough to reach by rowboat,
and there are
tourists over there,
so I don't think you need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even hearing that,
I can't help but worry.
I immediately head out toward the islet she
mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Guess that was a decent swim.
Still not quite enough,
but time to head ba—)

text_block_list.name: Pierced Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I told you to stop following us!
You guys are so annoying! We're not interested,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Student on Vacation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! We're not hitting on you!
We just said we wanted to cheer for you
guys!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...What a pain in the ass.
...Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after arriving on the islet,
I stumble upon some students
and horsegirls in the middle of a heated
argument. I have to break this up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. They're just students.
Having spent so much time with Sirius
Symboli,
I should easily be able to handle something
like this—!
choice_data_list: C-Could you please cut it out...?

text_block_list.name: Student on Vacation
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! That's our line!
You their chaperone or something?!
Make these rude chicks apologize!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant to deliver a sharp,
commanding rebuke like Sirius Symboli
would,
but my voice came out much more pathetic
than intended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have to protect our students.
I steady myself to confront them once more,
when—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Shut your yaps.
I'm not in the mood for useless noise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice,
low yet cutting through the air with icy
composure, silences the area.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the little pup learned how to
bare its teeth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'd praise you,
but barking at a bunch of summer bugs won't
accomplish anything.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Student on Vacation
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who the hell are you...

text_block_list.name: Pierced Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-senpai~!
These guys are seriously persistent!
They keep saying they'll cheer for us if
we're strong!

text_block_list.name: Student on Vacation
text_block_list.text:
W-We just...
asked for your names so we could root for
you...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh. How generous of you.

text_block_list.name: Student on Vacation
text_block_list.text:
Wh...
What?
You gonna tell us your name instead then?
I mean, that works too... We'll cheer for you,
so... haha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The students shrink back from the overwhelming
aura Sirius Symboli radiates.
Her sharp glare,
intimidating enough to pin them in place,
is like that of a wolf.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll tell you.
Look for the brightest star in the sky.
Your answer's right there.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Simple enough, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli makes no attempt to placate
them.
She speaks with the commanding presence of
a solitary sovereign demanding total
fealty.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Only one will take the victory.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: And that's me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nobody else gets to stand before me.
...Got it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...If you get it,
get the hell out of here.
Before you get lost in the dark on your boat
ride back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Absolute charisma.
A dazzling,
searing light stood right before me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not a single soul uttered another word.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soon,
Sirius Symboli and I were the only ones left
on the islet.
Enveloped by nothing but the sound of the
crashing waves—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's the brightest star out there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was she referring to our conversation earlier?
Conventionally speaking, the Sun?
Yet right now...
that didn't feel like the right answer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I bit through my leash a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'll make them all realize.
How utterly foolish it is to be kept on a
leash by meaningless ties.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That right here, right now,
is a star that will burn everything to
ash—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I'll make them learn their lesson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unyielding resolve to shine with her
own blinding light,
and the fearless strength to stand tall and
declare herself supreme—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Those were the very things that forged
the Sirius Symboli of today.
There was no way I could keep from being
drawn to that brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in that exact moment,
I made my decision.
choice_data_list: I'll become a Trainer worthy of you.
I'll become a Trainer worthy of st...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Wishful thinking?
You've certainly learned how to talk big.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold my breath,
but I won't shoot you down either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You'd better watch yourself, though.
Make sure you don't burn to ash at my
side.
